results.description:
Cast Demonic Consultation by paying {B}, naming Thassa's Oracle and thus exiling your library due to you not having a card named Thassa's Oracle in your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

Cast Tainted Pact by paying {1}{B}, exiling your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.
results.easyPrerequisites: No two cards in library share a name.

results.description:
Cast Doomsday by paying {B}{B}{B}, searching your library and graveyard for any five other cards, exiling all other cards from your graveyard and library, and then placing the remaining cards on top of your library and losing half your life, rounded up.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, winning the game.
results.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least three devotion to blue.

results.description:
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}, drawing your library and then putting any card besides Thassa's Oracle from your hand on top of your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

Activate Hermit Druid by paying {G} and tapping it, reveal cards from the top of your library and then putting them into your graveyard.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, winning you the game.
results.notablePrerequisites:
Hermit Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You have no basic lands in library.

results.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
Leveler enters the battlefield, triggering itself, exiling your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, triggering itself, causing you to win the game.

Activate Thought Lash by exiling the top card of your library, preventing the next one damage that would be dealt to you this turn.
Repeat step 1 until there are no cards in your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield winning you the game.

Cast Paradigm Shift by paying {1}{U}, exiling your library and shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.
results.notablePrerequisites: The number of cards in your graveyard is less than two plus your devotion to blue.

results.description:
Cast Oracle for {U}{U}.
Tap and activate Divining Witch's ability for {1}{B} and discarding a card while your Oracle trigger is on the stack, naming a card not in your library.
Resolve Witch ability, exiling your library.
Resolve Oracle trigger, winning the game.

Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your library and choosing to put no cards on top of your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

Cast Doomsday Excruciator by paying six {B}.
When Doomsday Excruciator enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to exile all but the bottom six cards of their library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
When Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to win the game.
results.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 4.

results.description:
Cast Underworld Breach.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Memnite, milling yourself for three.
Cast Memnite by exiling three cards from your graveyard that are not Thassa's Oracle.
Grinding Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat steps 2 to 4 until you have no cards in your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle.
Thassa's Oracle triggers, winning you the game.
results.notablePrerequisites: You have four or more cards in your graveyard.

results.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves by paying {0}, attaching it to Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Whenever a permanent card is put into your graveyard, exile it with a croak counter.
Activate Lightning Greaves by paying {0}, attaching it to Grolnok.
Repeat step 1 through 4 until your devotion to blue is greater than or equal to the number of cards in your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle from exile by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, winning you the game.

Play Oracle.
Exile entire library to Devourer in response to etb.
Let Oracle resolve and win.

Cast Dance with Calamity by paying {7}{R}, exiling your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
When Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to win the game.

Activate Nomads en-Kor, targeting Cephalid Illusionist.
Mill 3.
Repeat this process until you mill your entire library.
When you mill Narcomoeba, put it on the battlefield.
Flashback Dread Return, sacrificing Nomads en-Kor, Cephalid Illusionist, and Narcomoeba, targeting Thassa's Oracle.
Resolve Thassa's Oracle's trigger with no cards in your library.

Cast Mana Severance by paying {1}{U}, searching for all land cards in your library, exiling them and shuffling your library.
Cast Selective Memory by paying {3}{U}, exiling the rest of your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

Activate Sacred Guide for {1}{W}, exiling your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle, winning the game on ETB.
results.notablePrerequisites: There are no white cards in library.

results.description:
Cast Angel's Grace.
Cast Spoils of the Vault naming a card not in your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle winning the game.

Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck size is less than or equal to 2 plus your devotion to blue.
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}. When it enters, it triggers, causing you to win the game.

Cast Spoils of the Vault by paying {B}, naming any card not in your library, exiling your entire library and losing life equal to the number of cards exiled this way.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

Cast Underworld Breach by paying {1}{R}.
Kykar, Wind's Fury triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token with flying.
Underworld Breach resolves.
Activate Kykar by sacrifice a Spirit token, adding {R}.
Cast Burning Inquiry by paying {R}.
Kykar, Wind's Fury triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token with flying.
Resolve Bruning Inquiry, causing each player to draw three cards, then discard three cards at random.
Activate Kykar by sacrifice a Spirit token, adding {R}.
Cast Burning Inquiry from the graveyard for its escape cost by paying {R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Repeat until you have two or fewer cards in your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield and triggers, causing you to win the game.
results.notablePrerequisites: At least one additional card in your graveyard.

results.description:
Activate Frenetic Efreet's ability an arbitrarily large number of times.
Draw cards from Zndrsplt's trigger upon successful coinflips until there are no cards in your library.
In response to Frenetic Efreet's next activation on the stack, cast Red Elemental Blast targeting Zndrsplt.
The rest of Frenetic Efreet's activations do nothing to the boardstate and can be skipped.
Cast Thassa's Oracle.

feature.name: Infinite tapped creature tokens with haste

Activate a token copy of Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untap Kiki-Jiki.

Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.
